notes.text: The svg is the element; WordPress's span.x-icon wrapper goes. Colour is currentColor only.

The names are the union of both platforms' glyphs, listed in contract/sections.json under icons and split into content names an editor may choose and chrome names only the system draws (SC-007). Both platforms draw every name; the artwork stays each platform's own. The gate refuses an icon name in markup or fields that the list lacks.
